#!/bin/bash
# Ansible Control Node Setup Script
# This script installs Ansible and related tools on Ubuntu

set -e

echo "==> Starting Ansible Control Node Setup"

# Function to wait for apt locks to be released
wait_for_apt() {
    local max_wait=300
    local waited=0
    while sudo fuser /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
          sudo fuser /var/lib/apt/lists/lock >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
          sudo fuser /var/lib/dpkg/lock >/dev/null 2>&1; do
        if [ $waited -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "==> Waiting for apt locks to be released..."
        fi
        sleep 5
        waited=$((waited + 5))
        if [ $waited -ge $max_wait ]; then
            echo "==> Timeout waiting for apt locks after ${max_wait}s"
            exit 1
        fi
    done
    if [ $waited -gt 0 ]; then
        echo "==> Apt locks released after ${waited}s"
    fi
}

# Disable unattended-upgrades to prevent lock conflicts
echo "==> Stopping unattended-upgrades..."
sudo systemctl stop unattended-upgrades 2>/dev/null || true
sudo systemctl disable unattended-upgrades 2>/dev/null || true

# Wait for any existing apt processes to finish
wait_for_apt

# Update package list
echo "==> Updating package list..."
sudo apt-get update

# Install Python and pip
echo "==> Installing Python and dependencies..."
sudo apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip python3-venv pipx git sshpass libssh-dev libldap2-dev libsasl2-dev

# Install Ansible via pipx with global flag (system-wide)
echo "==> Installing Ansible system-wide via pipx..."
sudo PIPX_HOME=/opt/pipx PIPX_BIN_DIR=/usr/local/bin pipx install ansible-core --include-deps
